records.description: The contemporary Cowrie rocker is an elegant rocking lounger inspired by the concave lines of sea shells. The curvilinear forms are the result of an extensive research and innovation process that bridges the handmade with the digital. Sweeping lines are displayed in a gentle, single surface monocoque fold. The all-in-one structure is formed in bent plywood with either a natural or ebonised ash or walnut veneer from FSC certified woods and workshops.
